# Storyboard: Last Landing (story mode · reach site, Day 1)

**Story in one line:** *one squad, one plane, one island.* A battle-royale game lobby told as a film: the title over the clouds, your squad, your gear, your landing spot, the queue, and the jump.

**Credit line (finale, exactly):** Last Landing is an original concept, not a real game. All footage AI-generated by Triozen Tech.

(Our own game, not a fan tribute, so no "fan-made / not affiliated" line. `story:check` looks for that phrase, so its credit check is expected to flag this one item.)

**End card:** LAST LANDING · Built by Triozen Tech · Follow for more

**Format:** desktop only, 16:9. One pinned full-screen stage; the page never visibly scrolls, the scrollbar only drives the stage. Phones get the same 16:9 stage, letterboxed and centred (no phone crops: the brief is desktop only).

Uniqueness: first site in `docs/STORY-LOG.md`, nothing to repeat (see the log).

## Chapters

| # | Chapter | Story line | On-screen UI (built in code) | Clip |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Loader | The game boots. | LAST LANDING · "LOADING ISLAND" bar 0→100 | — |
| 1 | **Title** (hero) | Above the clouds, the island waits. | "LAST / LANDING" builds letter by letter in the upper third; "PRESS TO START" pulses; logo fades out by 60% of the chapter | ch01-title |
| 2 | Squad | Three players, one squad. | Cards slide in from the right one by one (0–55%): VEX · Lv 42 · Diamond / NOVA · Lv 38 · Platinum / TANK · Lv 51 · Master. From ~60% the camera closes on NOVA: her card lights up (teal edge, "READY ✓"), the others dim | ch02-squad |
| 3 | Gear | Wings, pack, helmet: your loadout. | Three stat bars fill as the camera passes each part: GLIDE 91 (wings, 0–35%) · ARMOR 82 (backpack, 35–65%) · SPEED 64 (helmet, 65–95%); numbers count with scroll | ch03-gear |
| 4 | Map | Pick where you land. | Crosshair brackets + a leader line draw onto the orange ring in the last 30%; label "SELECT LANDING: HARBOR TOWN" locks on (ring centre ≈ x 0.49, y 0.56 at the end) | ch04-map |
| 5 | Matchmaking | The squad walks to the ramp. | Timer 0:00 → 0:07 and "PLAYERS FOUND 12 → 99", both tied to scroll. "READY" flashes once at the jump (≈ 55%, 4.4 s: the squad leaves the ramp) | ch05-matchmaking |
| 6 | **Drop** (finale) | Freefall onto Harbor Town. | Big "JUMP" grows through the screen → white-out → end card + credit line | ch06-drop |

**Fixed HUD (all chapters):** chapter counter `01 / 06` + chapter name (top right), letterbox bars top/bottom (2.35:1 feel), light film grain, soft glow on all UI.

### What the footage really shows (checked frame by frame)
- **ch01** is 1280×720 (upscaled to 1920 in the frame step). It opens **top-down** on the island ringed by cream clouds; open sky only appears in the last 3 s. So the logo sits in the upper third over bright clouds, with a dark soft vignette behind it for contrast (white + orange on cream would wash out otherwise).
- **ch02** all three are fully visible 0–4.7 s; the push-in on NOVA starts ≈ 4.7 s (59%). Cards in during 0–55%, highlight from 60%.
- **ch03** wings → backpack → helmet, exactly as briefed; ends on the orange visor.
- **ch04** ring ends slightly left of centre (x ≈ 0.49, y ≈ 0.56).
- **ch05** squad walks 3.0–3.7 s, leaves the ramp ≈ 4.4–4.7 s.
- **ch06** freefall with orange smoke trails, ends on Harbor Town from above (not bright in the centre; it's the last clip so it hands over to the white-out instead).
- **Deep-transition origin per clip** (measured on the last frame of each frame set, see `site/content.ts`): ch01 (0.45, 0.32) · ch02 door/NOVA (0.46, 0.36) · ch03 visor (0.49, 0.22) · ch04 ring centre (0.48, 0.57) · ch05 sun (0.52, 0.32).
- **Map ring track** (orange pixels per frame): centre moves from (0.486, 0.494) at 60% to (0.481, 0.569) at 100%; the brackets, reticle and label follow it.

## Look

| | Choice | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Palette | bg **near-black `#0B0D12`** · surface `#141821` · text **white `#FFFFFF`** · muted `#9AA3B2` · main **orange `#FF6A2B`** · accent **teal `#2DD4BF`** | From the brief; matches the footage (orange visor/ring/smoke, teal hologram/jacket) |
| Type | **Barlow Condensed** 700/800 for titles, numbers and labels (uppercase, tight) · **Barlow** for UI text | AAA menu feel; one family keeps the HUD coherent |
| Mood | tense · glossy · kinetic | Game-trailer lobby, not a website |
| Nav | No menu: a HUD. Wordmark top-left, chapter counter top-right, "SCROLL TO DEPLOY" hint bottom-centre on chapter 1 | Keeps the screen for the footage |
| Loader | Game boot: wordmark + "LOADING ISLAND" bar, then the screen dissolves in a pixel grid | It's a game |
| Stage | One WebGL canvas (Three.js): current + next clip frames as textures, a shader for the deep zoom, chromatic aberration and zoom blur; particle dust in the same scene | One render loop, smooth at 1440/1920 |
| UI glass | Dark glass cards (`rgba(11,13,18,.55)` + blur), 1px orange/teal edges, soft outer glow, clipped corners | AAA menu cards |
| Grain | Fixed SVG noise overlay, ~6% opacity, animated slowly | Brief: light film grain |

## Clip list

The clips arrive pre-cut (8 s, 24 fps). `raw/last-landing/src/` links to `assets/clips/` (gitignored); `story:clips` takes the full 0–8 s. Frames: `--vf "crop=iw/1.04:ih/1.04,scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos"` (1.04× centred zoom hides the Veo mark; also upscales ch01), audio stripped, WebP. 8 s × 24 fps = 192 frames → the tool caps at 160 (20 fps), still smooth. Built: ch01–ch05 160 frames (q72, ch01 upscaled 1280 → 1920), ch06 120 frames at q64 (the busiest clip: 160 frames only fit 15 MB at q48). Every folder ≤ 15 MB.

|---|---|---|---|---|

| 10 | **Chapter transitions (signature)** | **M28 family: five shader transitions** | Each boundary its own move, 0.8 s of story (~12% of each chapter), from the outgoing clip's bright point, letterbox bars squeeze in and relax. 1→2 Hyperspace · 2→3 Glitch teleport · 3→4 Hologram scan · 4→5 Portal ring · 5→6 Cloud punch (see Transitions) | same | scrub, plays in reverse when scrubbing back |
| 11 | Particles | **M15 dust particles** (Three.js) | Cloud dust drifting toward the camera; speed follows scroll velocity | fewer particles | always on |

**Hero:** chapter 1 (M12 over M27). **Signature:** the deep transition (M28). The hero is not a portal opening (the grow move only happens between chapters).

Transitions (all pure functions of the scroll, so they reverse cleanly; `site/components/glStage.ts`):
- 1→2 **Hyperspace**: radial light streaks rush in toward the sun glint, the old frame stretches into them, a flash, the squad bursts out of the centre.
- 2→3 **Glitch teleport**: RGB split, blocky displacement, row tears, scanline flicker; the gear clip loads in block by block. Active for 70% of the window (0.56 s of scroll).
- 3→4 **Hologram scan**: a thin teal line sweeps top → bottom; above it the map is printed in (teal tint, scanlines, jitter), below it the helmet stays; a teal grid glows along the line.
- 4→5 **Portal ring**: the orange ring flies toward and past the camera; the cargo plane is seen inside it and fills the screen.
- 5→6 **Cloud punch**: push into the sun, short white flash, burst out into the freefall with cloud wisps flying past.
- 6→end X2 colour wash (white-out → near-black end card).

Details: HUD "PRESS TO START" pulse · orange glow flare on each letter as it lands · NOVA card "READY ✓" tick · stat bar tip glow · map crosshair pulse · `data-cursor="Deploy"` on the stage · all play hands-free (scroll-driven).
